A given name (also known as a forename or first name ) is the part of a personal name [ 1 ] that identifies a person, possibly with one or more middle names as well, and differentiates that person from the other members of a group (typically a family or clan ) who have a common surname . The term given name refers to a name usually bestowed at or close to the time of birth, usually by the parents of the newborn. A Christian name is the first name given at baptism .
